contractDecision.nativeContract: Before retirement, directory-probe errors preserve the prior. Once a recorded replacement starts, retire/remove prior before acquiring the same native file lock; on failure remove/dispose the candidate and expose the error. Stored rows/media remain independently recoverable. No live fallback or ownership handoff.
